column1: # Install targets. One row per AI tool. See docs/multi-tool-design.md.
#   skill_global  global skill dir ('-' if the tool has no skills)
#   skill_project project skill dir ('-' if none)
#   rule_class    A = folder of per-rule files | B = single merged file
#   rule_global   A: global rule dir | B: global single file | '-' if no file-based global
#   rule_project  A: project rule dir | B: project single file
#   rule_fmt      converter function in scripts/lib/tools.sh (A class only; '-' for B)
#   rule_ext      extension for installed rule files (md, mdc, ...)
#   doc_url       official doc page, entry point for the tools-sync skill
# ~ expands to $HOME. --workspace DIR overrides the *_project paths' base.
